name: FMC Italy 2026
information: #🇮🇹 Questa competizione assegnerà il titolo di *campione nazionale 2026* per l'evento 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. Le location e il link per registrarsi si possono visualizzare [qui](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMCItaly2026) --- #🇬🇧 This competition will assign the title of *2026 national champion* for the event 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. Registration and locations can be found [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMCItaly2026) The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for FMC Italy 2026 as the number of spots for national title contenders is quite limited.
